crossRefs.note: So Joshua burned Ai and made it a heap forever, even a desolation, to this day.
You shall gather all its plunder into the middle of its street, and shall burn with fire the city, with all of its…
He burned Yahweh’s house, the king’s house, and all the houses of Jerusalem, even every great house, he burned with…
The ten horns which you saw, and the beast, these will hate the prostitute, will make her desolate, will strip her…
Therefore in one day her plagues will come: death, mourning, and famine; and she will be utterly burned with fire; for…
But all the silver, gold, and vessels of bronze and iron are holy to Yahweh. They shall come into Yahweh’s treasury.”

translations.web: They burned the city with fire, and all that was in it. Only they put the silver, the gold, and the vessels of bronze and of iron into the treasury of Yahweh’s house.
translations.bsb: Then the Israelites burned up the city and everything in it. However, they put the silver and gold and articles of bronze and iron into the treasury of the LORD’s house.
translations.kjv: And they burnt the city with fire, and all that was therein: only the silver, and the gold, and the vessels of brass and of iron, they put into the treasury of the house of the LORD.
translations.asv: And they burnt the city with fire, and all that was therein; only the silver, and the gold, and the vessels of brass and of iron, they put into the treasury of the house of Jehovah.
